## Release notes

Wyrm for iPhone 1.0.0 is the first official release, and it brings back
everything that was paused. Trails is
open, Team Mode and NTL tags are on again, and there's a new Near Original mode
that plays like the slither.io you remember. I also fixed a crash at launch on
some iPhones, the crashes when resizing the HUD, and the tag that flickered
every second. Thanks for every report you sent. They made this update.

### What's new

- **A welcome tour.** New here or just updated? A short tour shows you where
  everything is. Replay it any time from Settings â€º Help & feedback.
- **Trails is open.** Post photos, text or a canvas. Others can like it with a
  bead and reply. The photo editor has looks you swipe through, Adjust sliders,
  emoji stickers, and text with Glow and Line. Trails has its own tab, and
  Alerts moved to the bell on Play.
- **Near Original.** One switch on Home gives you slither's own minimap,
  leaderboard, joystick, boost and arrow, upright too.
- **Team Mode is back,** with a team roster and team chat right in the arena.
  Move them, resize them, recolour them, and fold the chat away. Sideways, the
  team chat now has its keyboard right in the arena.
- **NTL tags for everyone.** Others see your tag even without a team, and it
  swings just like it does in NTL, smooth at 120 Hz too.
- **New snake looks.** Skinless draws every snake as a clear strip in its own
  colour. Spine adds a thin line down every snake. In assist you can hide your
  own tag and accessories.
- **Play feel.** slither's own arrow movement, Look ahead (the camera leans
  where you're going), and a spring zoom bar.
- **Auto restart.** A new on-screen button. With it on, you jump straight back
  in after you die. It switches itself off if the arena drops you.
- **A cleaner minimap.** Your arrow is smaller, your teammates show without a
  second dot on top of you, and where you died last time is a red ring.
- **Leaderboard.** Your row stands out, and you can search the Score and Kills
  boards.
- **Global chat** shows how many new messages are waiting.

### Fixed

- Wyrm could crash right at launch on some iPhones.
- Resizing any HUD element (stats, keys, leaderboard, minimap, team, chat)
  could crash the game.
- Tags flickered once a second and went stiff and straight in turns.
- Build a Wyrm beads could draw wrong or vanish while scrolling.
- A custom pattern could lose its last bead in the arena.
- Skinless snakes could fold and break when they curled into a tight loop.

### Heads up

- **Video trails are coming later.** Photos, text and canvas work today.
- **Live voice on iPhone is still on its way.**
- **Profiles no longer show badges** or the Best/Kills/Beads chips. Something
  new is coming in their place.

---

## Changelog

All notable changes since the last release, 0.18.24 (91), a beta. This release
also includes the test builds 92 to 106, which were never released.

### [1.0.0] (107) - 2026-10-06

#### Added
- App tour after an install or an update: a welcome, then a spotlight on Team
  mode, Near Original, Controls and its three tabs (Controls, On-screen
  buttons, Arena UI), and the Settings groups (Arena, Playing help,
  Performance, Account, Help & feedback). Skip any time; replay it from Help &
  feedback â€º Getting started
- Trails tab, feed and studio: photo, text and canvas trails, likes, replies
  and alerts
- Trails photo editor: 10 looks (by swipe or the Looks panel), Adjust
  (brightness, contrast, saturation, warmth), 32 emoji stickers, text Glow and
  Line
- Try this skin: a trail can carry the poster's skin and NTL tag
- Alerts open from a bell on Play
- Near Original mode (Home switch) with slither's own HUD, controls and fonts,
  upright as well
- Team roster and team chat in the arena, with size, opacity, width, height,
  colours, a BACK plate and a chat fold in the layout editor; a team chat
  composer in the match
- NTL tags shown to everyone, carried in the join the way NTL does it
- Skinless (fourth Snake rendering option) and Spine, in normal and assist;
  assist-only "Hide own tag and accessories"; preview on the Snake card
- slither's own arrow movement, Look ahead (Settings â€º Display â€º Camera) and a
  spring zoom bar style
- Auto restart on-screen button (Settings â€º On-screen buttons)
- Leaderboard search; your own row highlighted
- Global chat unread badge

#### Changed
- Team Mode, team chat and NTL tags are on again
- The tag rope runs NTL's own physics, in the arena and on the Skin tab
- The Wyrm HUD reads on any floor: an ink halo, names and scores in each
  snake's colour, a minimap tinted by the floor
- Your arrow on the minimap is half its old size; your own team entry no longer
  draws a dot over it
- The last-death mark is a red dot inside a red ring
- The sideways keyboard is phone-sized in the Ready Room, and it now comes up
  for team chat in a sideways match
- Build a Wyrm uses one bead grid; the colour wheel and Wyrm beads are on again
- Wyrm joins as the web client only
- The Trails feed loads 10 trails at a time and fetches the next page early
- The drop hint says what to try: "Close it, or turn off Wi-Fi and try to play
  at least once on mobile data."

#### Removed
- Profile badges and the Best/Kills/Beads chips

#### Fixed
- A launch crash when the screen could not be set up the first time
- HUD size sliders crashed the game
- Resizing the team roster crashed the game
- Tags flickered once a second and laid out straight in turns (each reconnect
  of the tag service reset every rope)
- No keyboard came up for team chat in a sideways match
- Build a Wyrm beads drew wrong or vanished on scroll
- A custom pattern lost its last bead in the arena
- Skinless loops folded or broke

#### Security
- New settings follow your account like the rest. Nothing new leaves the phone
  except what you post to Trails
